thesis: Act as the neutral sub-ledger between flexibility aggregators and fleets of batteries, heat pumps, EV chargers or commercial loads. For each called event, bind consent, device measurements, baseline, activation and market statement; calculate the asset-owner share; and release or reconcile payment only when the aggregator's event is settled. Installer and OEM integrations provide one-to-many distribution, while verified event outcomes improve device-specific baseline and availability models.
